segments.title: Musical Cold Open: Pepito, Jeff Ripple, and Crum Perform Original Songs
segments.notes: Pepito opens as 'Papita the dog,' Jeff Ripple debuts a smooth R&B ballad about himself, and Crum delivers a glitchy auto-tuned track about being 'crumbelievable' before the official broadcast countdown.

segments.title: Trump–Musk Feud Dominates; Kendall Visits; Neighbor CIA Saga Recounted
segments.notes: Case, Pepito, Crum, and Kendall dissect the escalating Trump–Elon public breakup, debate the 'America Party,' and Case recounts the summer-long neighbor confrontation involving CIA claims and a parking lot standoff.

segments.title: Trailer Reviews: Tetsuo, Architectone, Iron Man Game
segments.notes: Trent (introduced as Chet's son) and Guy Redacted watch and discuss the Tetsuo: The Iron Man trailer, an architecture documentary trailer, and a Marvel Iron Man game trailer heavy on body-horror imagery.

segments.title: Who Gets Joe Rogan in the Divorce: Trump or Elon?
segments.notes: Crum and Munch debate which billionaire retains Joe Rogan's allegiance; Crum reveals he is $55,000 from clearing his $300,000 gorilla gambling debt, and Munch rallies chat votes for the gorilla punch.

segments.title: Guy Redacted Teaches Dark Debate Arts; Demonstrates on Chet and Chat
segments.notes: Guy Redacted hosts a solo segment dissecting 'debate conspiracy' videos, then field-tests ten manipulation techniques—including judo concession, Socratic questioning, and contrast effect—on a disguised Chet and chat participants.

segments.title: Jay Drilla Rapid-Fire News & Ted Turner Interview
segments.notes: New artist Jay Drilla speed-runs viewer-submitted headlines (Amazon humanoid robots, 200-year-old condom, pet yeast, AI attractiveness rating) before interviewing a Ted Turner impersonator who claims ownership of every network starting with T.

segments.title: Therapy with Dr. Chath: Jay Drilla Embraces Flies and Fart Philosophy
segments.notes: Dr. Chath counsels Jay Drilla on fly swarms, daddy issues, and the universal truth that every historical figure has ripped an asshole-shredding fart; Jay declares a breakthrough and exits.

segments.title: DJ C4 & Ghost Writer Craft 'Sleep Aura' with Sleepy Boy
segments.notes: DJ C4 summons the undead Ghost Writer to pen a rebellious sleep-themed track, then records Sleepy Boy—fresh off experimental 'psychophagia' surgery—over a copyright-free beat, iterating through multiple vocal passes and a sleeping-pill laundry list.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Lead Anchor. Anchored the Trump–Musk feud coverage, recounted the CIA neighbor saga, and managed the broadcast's three-segment limit.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: Executive Producer. Opened the show as 'Papita the dog,' fired graphics for the feud coverage, and later appeared as a DJ C4 collaborator.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: Correspondent. Debuted an original R&B ballad about his own romantic prowess during the cold open.

characters.name: Crum (Leonard Crum)
characters.notes: Debate Analyst. Sang a glitchy auto-tuned track in the cold open; revealed $55K remaining on $300K gorilla gambling debt and guest-house living arrangement.

Lives in a guest house separate from partner Belulia [01:19:23]

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: In-Studio Contributor. Walked through the studio, shared birthday timeline (June 13th), promoted weekend streams, and confirmed sister no longer hates Case.
lore_notes: Sister no longer hates Case; neighbor CIA incident fizzled after Case's cordial text strategy [40:02, 43:18]

characters.name: Chet (Chet Manscape)
characters.notes: Chief Science Correspondent. Appeared as 'Trent' (claimed son) and later as debate dummy for Guy Redacted's manipulation techniques; defended science via faith-in-God argument.
lore_notes: Introduced a teenage 'son' persona named Trent [53:19]

characters.name: Guy Redacted
characters.notes: Segment Host. Hosted a solo segment teaching ten dark debate tactics, successfully demonstrating them on Chet and chat; claimed ghost-wrote every Pink song.
lore_notes: Claims authorship of all Pink songs [03:30:07]

characters.name: Munch (Ralph Munchcut)
characters.notes: Debate Analyst. Rallied chat votes for Crum's gorilla punch, argued Joe Rogan stays with Trump, and mocked Crum's 'moose-boosh' speaking style.

characters.name: Jay Drilla
characters.notes: Guest Artist / Fill-In Host. Debuted as up-and-coming musician, speed-ran news headlines, rated own AI attractiveness, interviewed Ted Turner, and received therapy.
lore_notes: Had 'song installation surgery' on thyroid limiting vocal range [02:24:30]

characters.name: Dr. Chath
characters.notes: Therapist. Counseled Jay Drilla on flies, daddy issues, and the universal fart equality principle; accepted spider-web joint hit.

characters.name: Ted Turner
characters.notes: Guest (Impersonator). Claimed ownership of every network starting with T, advocated sun worship via 18 visor-bearers, and declared himself 'sexy crazy' vs. Vince McMahon.

characters.name: DJ C4
characters.notes: Musical Producer. Orchestrated collaborative 'Sleep Aura' track with Ghost Writer and Sleepy Boy, explaining AI-branding revenue model.

characters.name: Sleepy Boy
characters.notes: Guest Artist. Recorded vocals for 'Sleep Aura' after experimental 'psychophagia' surgery; fell asleep mid-session.

characters.name: Ghost Writer
characters.notes: Undead Lyricist. Claimed all songs ever written were authored by ghosts; supplied sleep-themed word bank and sleeping-pill list via ChatGPT.

episode_summary: Barely Informed News led with the Trump–Musk feud as 'battle of the century,' featuring a musical cold open, Kendall's studio visit, and a Munch & Crum debate on Joe Rogan custody that advanced the Crum Dick Punch storyline. The broadcast then cycled through a Chet Guy the Science Eyes trailer review, a Guy Redacted masterclass in debate manipulation, a Jay Drilla rapid-news hour with a Ted Turner interview, a Therapy session on universal fart equality, and a marathon DJ C4 songwriting session producing the sleep-rebellion anthem 'Sleep Aura' with an undead ghost writer and a post-surgery Sleepy Boy.
